request: In Flow's top bar, right of the scope tabs (scopeTabs), add a label with the id labelCounts that shows how many of the board's cards carry each label, in the order bug, feature, design, chore, as "bug 3 · feature 4 · design 3 · chore 2", kept up to date as cards are added.

reference.message: How many cards carry each label, in the top bar

add./program/toolbar.lisp/label-counts:
(defn label-counts "How many of the cards carry each label, in the label filter's order." [cards]
  (join " · "
        (map (fn [tag] (str tag " " (count (filter (fn [card] (= (:tag card) tag)) cards))))
             ["bug" "feature" "design" "chore"])))

set./program/toolbar.lisp/top-bar:
(defview top-bar "The top bar: the logo and the board's name, the scope tabs and who is on the board." []
  `(node#topBar :dir auto :anchors {:left 220 :right 0 :top 0} :height 48 :color @color.topBar
     (label#logo :runs [{:icon box}
                        "  Flow  "
                        {:text ~(str "›  " (:label (find (fn [it] (= it.id state.boardId)) state.boards)))
                         :color @color.topMuted}]
       :textColor @color.topText
       :anchors {:left 16 :top 0 :bottom 0}
       :width 196
       :align {:horizontal start :vertical center})
     (node#panel-top-bar :anchors {:left 216 :top 16 :bottom 16} :width 1 :color @color.topLine)
     (row#scopeTabs :gap 2 :anchors {:left 228 :top 10} :width 360 :height 28 :role tablist :arrows horizontal
       ~(repeat [scope state.scopes]
         `(node#scopeTab :style ~(if (= state.scope scope) "toolButtonOn" "toolButton")
            :borderWidth ~(if (= state.scope scope) 1 0)
            :text ~(t (str "scope." scope))
            :role tab
            :selected ~(= state.scope scope)
            :onClick ~(handler chooseScope scope))))
     (label#labelCounts :text ~(label-counts computed.allCards)
       :textColor @color.topMuted
       :anchors {:left 600 :top 0 :bottom 0}
       :width 320
       :align {:vertical center})
     ~(members-menu)))
